module_name: FFmpeg Libraries In-Process Video Decode Adapter
adapter_policy: A replaceable decoder in the catalog chain (driver libav_v1), built only with the libav feature of a program. The FFmpeg libraries (LGPL shared build) decode the saved video stream inside the calling process and give the same pictures, timestamps and packed layout as the FFmpeg CLI adapter: the same seek (key picture before the start, earlier pictures dropped), the same filters (qnc_ffmpeg_decode::video_filter) and the same checks of the shared decode contract (qnc-media-decode pump). Proven byte for byte against the CLI (tests/same_as_cli.rs: whole stream, starts, 4:2:0 conversion, deinterlace, each field, half rate, a camera original). Audio and any request it does not take go through the FFmpeg CLI adapter with the same executable; a program built without the feature decodes the registration through that adapter. It consumes only a seekable file CodecEndpoint produced by the storage owner/resolver, never an HTTP or raw TCP endpoint, runs no probe, owns no clock and knows no application.
